paragraph:
# Velmoria's constitutional convention

*One hundred and eighty years on, a debate over emergency powers tests whether a republic can amend itself without (resurrect)ing the autocrat*

LET THIS chapter open on a (tempestuous) debate. One hundred and eighty years after the marshal fell, Velmoria convened a constitutional convention—the first in a generation—to consider whether its founding (corpus) of law needed amendment. The question that supplied the (impetus): should the republic (enact) emergency powers to meet modern (threat)s, or would such an (apparatus) merely (resurrect) the marshal's ghost? The debate was no (offbeat) academic exercise; it was a contest for the republic's soul.

The case for reform was made with (tact) by a (technocrat) of considerable (intellect). The world had changed, she argued; the founding (corpus) was in places (defunct), its emergency provisions a (conspectus) of an earlier age. To meet a sudden (threat)—a plague, a cyberattack, an invasion launched at some foreign tyrant's (fiat)—the republic needed an (apparatus) able to act with (exact) speed. A (discreet), tightly bounded emergency power, she insisted, would not (beget) tyranny but (counteract) it. Her (opus) of a proposal was meticulous, every (facet) considered, every (caveat) spelled out.

The case against was made with equal (intellect) and greater fear. To (construct) any emergency (apparatus), the opponents warned, was to forge a (duct) through which power could flow back to a single hand. The marshal had risen through exactly such a (compact)—a (pact) of "temporary" powers that he refused to (retract). Every (autocrat) in history had begun as a (discreet) reformer promising to (counteract) some (threat). To (enact) emergency powers, however bounded, was to (whet) the appetite of the next would-be (colossus).

Recall how the marshal had used emergency power. He declared a perpetual crisis, an endless (threat), and ruled by (fiat) and (edict). He would (indict) the innocent, (evict) the troublesome, (convict) the loyal-but-doubtful, and (mulct) the prosperous of their wealth. His secret police could (abduct) a citizen at midnight; his courts returned whatever (verdict) he demanded. The "emergency" never ended; the (apparatus) of crisis became the permanent (status) of the state. To (entreat) him to (retract) the powers was futile; he would only (protract) the crisis to justify keeping them.

The convention, (chasten)ed by that memory, refused to be (browbeat)en by either fear or urgency. It would neither (genuflect) before the (technocrat)'s promise of efficiency nor (retreat) into a (pusillanimous) refusal to adapt. The delegates—a (distinct) (nexus) of jurists, citizens, and scholars, representing every (dialect) and (sect) and region of the (populous) republic—undertook to (dissect) the proposal with care. They would (extract) what was wise and discard whatever would (detract) from the republic's safety, build a (consensus) rather than impose a (fiat).

The debate was long and, at moments, (tempestuous). A (spat) broke out between an idealistic (cadet) of the reform faction and a grizzled old (aristocrat) of the opposition. A (mischievous) delegate, more (gnat) than statesman, tried to (protract) the proceedings with (offbeat) procedural games. There were those who would (browbeat) the doubtful and those who would (entreat) them; (turncoat)s who switched sides for (cachet); a (technocrat) who droned on like a (chorus) of one until even his allies begged for a (hiatus). It was democracy in its messy, (corpus)-and-blood reality.

But the convention held to its (impetus): to amend without endangering. The (consensus) that slowly emerged was a (feat) of constitutional craftsmanship. Yes, the republic would (enact) a limited emergency (apparatus)—but hedged with every (caveat) the founders' wisdom and the marshal's example could supply. Any emergency power would (retract) automatically after a fixed term, with no power to (protract) it. The legislature could (interdict) its abuse; the courts could (dissect) its use; a supermajority could (resurrect) full normalcy at any time. The (duct) of power was built with a hundred valves, each able to shut it.

The reform's opponents extracted further safeguards. No emergency could (evict), (abduct), (indict), or (convict) outside the ordinary courts. None could (mulct) a citizen of property by mere (edict). The (apparatus) would be subject to a continuous (census) of its actions, an audit no official could (suspect) of bias. Every (aspect) of its use would be a matter of public record, open to (inspect)ion. The republic would (counteract) the very temptation it was creating. It was, the delegates agreed, the most (discreet) emergency power ever devised—built by people who knew exactly what they feared.

Beyond the convention hall, ordinary life kept its (dulcet) round. A plumber fixed a dripping (faucet); a nurse readied a (lancet) and a (hemostat) in the clinic; a child showed off a new (gadget) at school. A grandmother worked her (crochet) by the window; a vendor sold cloth by the (carat)-weight of its gold thread and knotted a bright (cravat) for a customer. At the zoo, a (walrus) basked by its pool and a (midget) pony gave rides; in the botanical garden, a (cactus) and a tall (eucalyptus) shared the arid (habitat); an (acrobat) practiced on a wire strung over the old (moat). A scholar unrolled a fragment of (papyrus); a (prophet)-like street preacher hurled a harmless (epithet) at the passing crowd, who laughed. There was no (gallows) in the square, no (threat) in the air—only the (dulcet), unremarkable peace of a free people.

The amendment passed—not by (fiat), nor in the heat of some narrow (spat), but by broad (consensus), after every (facet) had been examined and every (caveat) weighed. The republic had proven it could amend its own (corpus) of law, could (construct) new powers to meet new (threat)s, without (resurrect)ing the (autocrat). The (technocrat)'s efficiency and the traditionalist's caution had met in a (compact) that served both. It was, in its undramatic way, a (feat) worthy of the founders.

The episode entered the national (annals) as a lesson in self-amendment. A republic, the historians wrote, must be able to change—a (corpus) of law too rigid to adapt becomes (defunct), a (status) quo too brittle to bend. But it must change with (tact) and (caveat), lest in (construct)ing new powers it (beget) a new tyranny. The (discreet) genius of the convention lay not in refusing emergency power but in building it with so many checks that no (autocrat) could ever (extract) it for himself. To amend a constitution wisely, the lesson ran, is to (whet) its edge against tyranny, not for it.

So Velmoria, one hundred and eighty years free, learns that a living republic must (resurrect) neither its fears nor its tyrants, but must (construct), with (exact) care, the means to meet each new (threat) without surrendering self-rule. The marshal ruled by perpetual (edict) and (fiat), an emergency without end, an (apparatus) of crisis that became the permanent (status) of the state. His country, a century and four-fifths past his fall, has chosen the (converse)—to (enact) only powers that (retract) themselves, to hedge every emergency with a hundred (caveat)s, and to keep, beneath all the (tempestuous) debate of a free people amending their own law, the one (distinct), founding truth that no (threat) can (detract) from and no (technocrat)'s (protract)ed argument can obscure: that power lent to meet a crisis must always, by the people's own (fiat), return to the people when the crisis ends.

本批词根亮点：

• -tract 家族：tract/detract/retract/protract/extract/contract/attract/distract，全来自拉丁 trahere（拉），方向不同含义各异

• -duct 家族：duct/conduct/abduct/deduct/aqueduct/induct，来自 ducere（引导）

• -dict 家族：edict/indict/interdict/verdict（ver+dict=说真相）/predict/contradict，全是"说"的变体

• budget：英国财政大臣每年从皮包（法语 bougette）中取出预算方案

• cravat：来自克罗地亚（Croat）骑兵的围巾，17世纪法国时尚引入欧洲

• fiat：拉丁语"让它成为"，fiat lux=让光出现，fiat money=仅凭命令有效的法定货币

• crochet/cachet：法语词，t 不发音，前者"小钩"，后者"隐藏的印记=声誉

quiz.question: tempestuous ______
quiz.explanation: 暴风雨般的; 激烈的, 激烈的恋情. Their tempestuous affair ended in heartbreak. 他们激烈的恋情以心碎告终。 | tempest->暴风雨（拉丁tempestas），tempestuous->像暴风雨一样激烈的（cf. tempest暴风雨，temperature温度，temporal时间的） || 文化联想：中文“轰轰烈烈、吵吵合合的一段感情”最适合帮助记忆 tempestuous，可以说 **a tempestuous affair — “A relationship full of passion, arguments, breakups, and reconciliations can become a tempestuous affair.”**

quiz.question: mischievous _____
quiz.explanation: 淘气的; 恶作剧的, 淘气的恶作剧. The children played a mischievous prank on their teacher. 孩子们对老师玩了一个淘气的恶作剧。 | mischief->调皮（mis->坏，chief->头），mischievous->充满调皮的=淘气的（注意发音：mis-chi-vous，不是mis-chee-vi-ous） || 文化联想：中国孩子过节时偷偷恶作剧最适合帮助记忆 mischievous，可以说 **a mischievous prank — “A mischievous child may hide a cousin’s red envelope as a prank and then reveal it before anyone truly worries.”**

quiz.question: ______ rendezvous
quiz.explanation: 约会; 会面, 秘密约会. The spies arranged a secret rendezvous at midnight. 间谍安排了午夜的秘密约会。 | rendez->呈现，vous->你们（法语），rendezvous->将自己呈现于约定地点=约会（法国军事用语，注意z不发音） || 文化联想：抗战题材影视中的秘密接头最适合帮助记忆 rendezvous，可以说 **a secret rendezvous — “Two underground agents may arrange a secret rendezvous at a teahouse after dark.”**

quiz.question: opus ______
quiz.explanation: 作品, 巨著. The novel was considered the authors opus magnum. 这部小说被认为是作者的巨著。 | opus->作品（拉丁），opus->（音乐/文学）作品，magnum opus->伟大作品=巨著（cf. opera歌剧，operate操作） || 文化联想：《红楼梦》最适合帮助记忆 opus，可以说 **a magnum opus — “Dream of the Red Chamber is often regarded as a magnum opus of classical Chinese fiction.”**

quiz.question: _____ corpus
quiz.explanation: 文集; 全集, 人体. Medical students study the human corpus in anatomy class. 医学生在解剖课上研究人体。 | corpus->身体（拉丁），corpus->文集/人体（cf. corpse尸体，corporation公司=法人体，corporal肉体的，incorporate并入） || 文化联想：中国古籍整理中把一个作家的全部作品汇成文集最适合帮助记忆 corpus，可以说 **a literary corpus — “A scholar may study the complete literary corpus of Lu Xun to trace changes in style and thought.”**

quiz.question: walrus ____
quiz.explanation: 海象, 海象牙. The walrus tusk can grow up to three feet long. 海象牙可以长到三英尺长。 | walrus->海象（荷兰语walrus，来自古挪威hrosshvalr->马-鲸），walrus->海中的马/鲸=海象 || 文化联想：中国大型海洋馆里的海象长牙最适合帮助记忆 walrus，可以说 **a walrus tusk — “At a marine park, visitors may notice that an adult walrus has long tusks projecting downward from its mouth.”**

quiz.question: _______ chorus
quiz.explanation: 合唱; 合唱团, 歌唱合唱. The singing chorus performed a beautiful rendition. 歌唱合唱演唱了一首优美的曲目。 | chorus->舞蹈队/合唱（希腊choros），chorus->合唱（cf. choir合唱团，choreography编舞，choral合唱的） || 文化联想：学校合唱比赛最适合帮助记忆 chorus，可以说 **a school chorus — “A school chorus may sing together at a graduation ceremony with dozens of voices moving in harmony.”**

quiz.question: papyrus ______
quiz.explanation: 纸莎草纸, 纸莎草纸卷. Ancient Egyptians wrote on papyrus scroll documents. 古埃及人在纸莎草纸卷文件上书写。 | papyrus->纸莎草（希腊，来自埃及语），papyrus->纸莎草纸（cf. paper纸=从papyrus而来，Bible=用papyrus做的书） || 文化联想：中国学生学习古埃及文明时最容易遇到 papyrus，可以说 **a papyrus scroll — “In a museum lesson on ancient Egypt, students may see a papyrus scroll covered with old writing.”**

quiz.question: ________ census
quiz.explanation: 人口普查, 全国人口普查. The government conducts a national census every ten years. 政府每十年进行一次全国人口普查。 | cens->评估（拉丁censere），census->对人口的评估=人口普查（cf. censor审查官，censure谴责，assess评估） || 文化联想：中国全国人口普查最适合帮助记忆 census，可以说 **a national census — “A national census counts residents and collects basic demographic information across the country.”**

quiz.question: _____ consensus
quiz.explanation: 共识; 一致意见, 广泛共识. The committee reached a broad consensus on the issue. 委员会就该问题达成了广泛共识。 | con->共同，sens->感觉/同意，consensus->共同感受=共识（cf. consent同意，dissent异议，sense感觉） || 文化联想：中文“求同存异、达成共识”最适合帮助记忆 consensus，可以说 **reach a consensus — “After a long discussion, neighbors may reach a consensus on how to renovate a shared courtyard.”**

quiz.question: ________ colossus
quiz.explanation: 巨人; 巨像, 高耸的巨像. The ancient statue was a towering colossus overlooking the harbor. 这座古老的雕像是俯瞰港口的高耸巨像。 | Colossus->罗得岛巨像（世界七大奇迹），colossus->巨像/巨人（cf. colossal巨大的，Colosseum罗马圆形剧场） || 文化联想：乐山大佛巨大的体量最适合帮助记忆 colossus，可以说 **a stone colossus — “The Leshan Giant Buddha can appear like a stone colossus towering above the river.”**

quiz.question: _____ hiatus
quiz.explanation: 间断; 空隙, 短暂的间断. After a brief hiatus, the band resumed touring. 经过短暂的间断后,乐队恢复了巡演。 | hiatus->裂缝（拉丁hiare->张开），hiatus->中断/空隙（cf. yawn打哈欠=张开，gape张口，hiatus hernia裂孔疝） || 文化联想：中文“暂停一阵再继续”最适合帮助记忆 hiatus，可以说 **a brief hiatus — “A singer may take a brief hiatus from touring and return to the stage several months later.”**

quiz.question: __________ apparatus
quiz.explanation: 装置; 器械, 科学仪器. The laboratory is equipped with advanced scientific apparatus. 实验室配备了先进的科学仪器。 | ap->朝向，parat->准备（拉丁parare），apparatus->准备好的一整套=装置（cf. prepare准备，repair修理，separate分离） || 文化联想：中国实验室的一整套实验仪器最适合帮助记忆 apparatus，可以说 **scientific apparatus — “A university laboratory may contain scientific apparatus for measuring temperature, pressure, voltage, and chemical reactions.”**

quiz.question: ______ status
quiz.explanation: 地位; 状态, 社会地位. Wealth often correlates with social status. 财富常常与社会地位相关。 | status->站立的状态（拉丁stare），status->地位/状态（cf. state状态，statue雕像，statute法规，static静态） || 文化联想：中文“社会地位”最适合帮助记忆 status，可以说 **social status — “In a historical drama, official rank and family background may strongly influence a person’s social status.”**

quiz.question: ______ cactus
quiz.explanation: 仙人掌, 沙漠仙人掌. The desert cactus can survive extreme drought conditions. 沙漠仙人掌可以在极端干旱条件下生存。 | cactus->刺（希腊kaktos->西班牙洋蓟），cactus->多刺的植物=仙人掌（cf. cactus复数cacti或cactuses） || 文化联想：中国北方家庭阳台上常见耐旱仙人掌最适合帮助记忆 cactus，可以说 **a desert cactus — “A desert cactus stores water in thick tissues so it can survive long periods of drought.”**

quiz.question: _____ conspectus
quiz.explanation: 概要; 纲要, 简短的概要. The professor provided a brief conspectus of the course. 教授提供了课程的简短概要。 | con->共同，spect->看，conspectus->综合一览=概要（cf. inspect检查，prospect前景，spectacle奇观） || 文化联想：中文“把整门课先概览一遍”最适合帮助记忆 conspectus，可以说 **a brief conspectus — “At the start of a course, a professor may give a brief conspectus of the major topics students will study.”**

quiz.question: _____ fetus
quiz.explanation: 胎儿, 人类胎儿. The ultrasound showed a healthy human fetus. 超声波显示了一个健康的人类胎儿。 | fetus->后代（拉丁fetus->生育），fetus->未出生的胎儿（cf. fecund多产的，fertility生育力，fetal胎儿的） || 文化联想：中国医院产科超声检查最适合帮助记忆 fetus，可以说 **a human fetus — “An ultrasound can show the growth and movement of a human fetus during pregnancy.”**

quiz.question: _____ impetus
quiz.explanation: 推动力; 动力, 新的动力. The discovery gave fresh impetus to the research. 这一发现为研究提供了新的动力。 | im->进入，pet->冲（拉丁petere），impetus->冲进去的力量=推动力（cf. impetuous冲动的，compete竞争，petition请求） || 文化联想：中文“给项目注入新动力”最适合帮助记忆 impetus，可以说 **fresh impetus — “A successful pilot program can give fresh impetus to a larger reform effort.”**

quiz.question: eucalyptus ___
quiz.explanation: 桉树, 桉树油. Eucalyptus oil is used in many medicinal products. 桉树油用于许多药用产品。 | eu->好，kalypt->遮盖（希腊），eucalyptus->好遮盖的=桉树（花蕾有帽形盖子，cf. calypso卡利普索，apocalypse启示=揭盖子） || 文化联想：中国南方城市常见的桉树最适合帮助记忆 eucalyptus，可以说 **eucalyptus oil — “Eucalyptus leaves contain aromatic compounds used to produce eucalyptus oil.”**

quiz.question: ______ nexus
quiz.explanation: 联系; 连接, 社会联系. The city serves as a social nexus for the region. 这座城市是该地区的社会联系枢纽。 | nex->绑（拉丁nectere），nexus->连接/枢纽（cf. connect连接，annex吞并=绑过来，nexus复数nexus或nexuses） || 文化联想：上海作为长三角交通、商业和社交枢纽的形象最适合帮助记忆 nexus，可以说 **a regional nexus — “Shanghai functions as a regional nexus connecting finance, transport, trade, and culture.”**

quiz.question: gallows _____
quiz.explanation: 绞刑架, 黑色幽默. His gallows humor helped cope with difficult situations. 他的黑色幽默帮助应对困难的情况。 | gallows->绞刑架（古英语galga），gallows humor->面对死亡/绝境的幽默=黑色幽默（cf. gallow恐吓，cf. dark humor） || 文化联想：中文“苦中作乐的黑色幽默”最适合帮助记忆 gallows，可以说 **gallows humor — “People working under extreme pressure may use gallows humor to cope with situations that are otherwise frightening or grim.”**

quiz.question: ______ acrobat
quiz.explanation: 杂技演员, 马戏团杂技演员. The circus acrobat performed amazing aerial stunts. 马戏团杂技演员表演了惊人的空中特技。 | akro->高处，bat->走（希腊bainein），acrobat->在高处行走的人=杂技演员（cf. acrophobia恐高症，aerobics有氧运动） || 文化联想：中国杂技团走钢丝最适合帮助记忆 acrobat，可以说 **a circus acrobat — “A Chinese circus acrobat may balance high above the stage while performing on a narrow wire.”**

quiz.question: offbeat _____
quiz.explanation: 不寻常的; 非传统的, 不寻常的幽默. His offbeat humor appeals to a niche audience. 他不寻常的幽默吸引了小众观众。 | off->偏离，beat->节拍，offbeat->偏离正常节拍的=不寻常的（cf. beat节拍，deadbeat落魄者，heartbeat心跳） || 文化联想：中文“小众、脑洞清奇的幽默”最适合帮助记忆 offbeat，可以说 **offbeat humor — “A comedian whose jokes are strange, unexpected, and highly original may appeal through offbeat humor.”**

quiz.question: browbeat _______
quiz.explanation: 威吓; 恐吓, 威吓证人. The lawyer tried to browbeat witness during cross-examination. 律师在盘问时试图威吓证人。 | brow->眉毛/脸，beat->打，browbeat->用脸部表情威压=威吓（cf. brow眉毛，frown皱眉，browbeaten被威吓的） || 文化联想：中文“咄咄逼人地把证人问到不敢说话”最适合帮助记忆 browbeat，可以说 **browbeat a witness — “A lawyer who intimidates rather than questions fairly may try to browbeat a witness.”**

quiz.question: __________ feat
quiz.explanation: 功绩; 壮举, 非凡的壮举. Climbing Mount Everest is a remarkable feat. 攀登珠穆朗玛峰是一个非凡的壮举。 | feat->行为/功绩（古法语fait->做），feat->了不起的壮举（cf. feature特色，defeat失败=拆除壮举，facile容易的） || 文化联想：中国航天工程完成重大技术突破最适合帮助记忆 feat，可以说 **a remarkable feat — “Landing a spacecraft safely after a complex mission is a remarkable feat of engineering.”**

quiz.question: _______ threat
quiz.explanation: 威胁; 恐吓, 严重的威胁. Climate change poses a serious threat to humanity. 气候变化对人类构成严重的威胁。 | threat->威胁（古英语threat->人群/压力），threaten->威胁（cf. throng人群，cf. threat原意是施压使人恐惧） || 文化联想：中文“构成严重威胁”最适合帮助记忆 threat，可以说 **a serious threat — “A fast-moving wildfire can become a serious threat to nearby villages.”**

quiz.question: _________ retreat
quiz.explanation: 撤退; 退却, 战略性撤退. The general ordered a strategic retreat from the battlefield. 将军命令从战场进行战略性撤退。 | re->回，treat->拉（拉丁trahere），retreat->向后拉=撤退（cf. treat治疗，treaty条约=经过谈判拉拢的，retract撤回） || 文化联想：《三十六计》里的“以退为进”最适合帮助记忆 retreat，可以说 **a strategic retreat — “A commander may order a strategic retreat to preserve strength and fight later from a better position.”**

quiz.question: entreat _____
quiz.explanation: 恳求; 乞求, 恳求恩惠. She would entreat favor from the king. 她会向国王恳求恩惠。 | en->使，treat->拉/处置，entreat->拉着手恳求=乞求（cf. treat处理，retreat撤退，treaty条约，entreaty恳求） || 文化联想：中文“苦苦哀求”最适合帮助记忆 entreat，可以说 **entreat for help — “A desperate family may entreat officials for help after losing its home in a flood.”**

quiz.question: _____ caveat
quiz.explanation: 警告; 告诫, 法律警告. The contract included an important legal caveat. 合同包含了一项重要的法律警告。 | caveat->让他注意（拉丁，cavere->注意），caveat->警告条款（cf. cave小心，caveat emptor买者自负） || 文化联想：中文“先说一句但是……”最适合帮助记忆 caveat，可以说 **an important caveat — “A lawyer may support a proposal but add an important caveat about how it could be misused.”**

quiz.question: __ _________ fiat
quiz.explanation: 命令; 法令, 通过行政命令. The president ruled by executive fiat. 总统通过行政命令统治。 | fiat->让它成为（拉丁，fieri->成为），fiat->命令/法令（cf. fiat lux让光出现，fiat money法定货币=仅凭命令有效的货币） || 文化联想：fiat 是“凭命令生效”，可用中国学生学习法定货币概念时来记忆，可以说 **government fiat — “A currency may function as legal tender largely because it is recognized by government fiat rather than backed by a commodity.”**

quiz.question: ____ gnat
quiz.explanation: 小昆虫; 蚊蚋, 微小的蚊蚋. A tiny gnat buzzed around the picnic food. 一只微小的蚊蚋在野餐食物周围嗡嗡作响。 | gnat->蚊蚋（古英语gnætt），gnat->极小的昆虫（注意g不发音，cf. strain at a gnat=对小事斤斤计较） || 文化联想：中国夏夜灯旁飞来飞去的小飞虫最适合帮助记忆 gnat，可以说 **a tiny gnat — “A tiny gnat may buzz around a lamp on a humid summer evening.”**

quiz.question: _________ turncoat
quiz.explanation: 叛徒; 变节者, 政治叛徒. The political turncoat switched parties for personal gain. 政治叛徒为了个人利益转换了政党。 | turn->转，coat->外套，turncoat->把外套翻过来=变节者（传说来自士兵翻转军装颜色以示变节） || 文化联想：中文“墙头草、临阵变节”最适合帮助记忆 turncoat，可以说 **a political turncoat — “A politician who switches sides only when power changes hands may be condemned as a political turncoat.”**

quiz.question: ______ moat
quiz.explanation: 护城河, 城堡护城河. The castle moat protected the fortress from invaders. 城堡护城河保护堡垒免受入侵者侵害。 | moat->护城河（古法语mote->土堆/堤坝），moat->城堡外的水沟（cf. mound土堆，moat引申为Berkshire Hathaway的护城河隐喻） || 文化联想：故宫护城河最适合帮助记忆 moat，可以说 **a palace moat — “A broad moat surrounds parts of the Forbidden City and forms part of its defensive landscape.”**

quiz.question: _____'_ spat
quiz.explanation: 小争吵; 口角, 情侣的小争吵. They had a minor lover's spat but reconciled quickly. 他们有一次小的情侣争吵,但很快和解了。 | spat->小争吵（象声词，打一下的声音），spat->短暂小争吵（cf. spit吐，spatula抹刀，spatter飞溅） || 文化联想：中文“情侣闹了个小别扭”最适合帮助记忆 spat，可以说 **a lover’s spat — “A couple may have a brief lover’s spat over a small misunderstanding and reconcile later that evening.”**

quiz.question: ___ carat
quiz.explanation: 克拉, 一克拉. The diamond ring weighed one carat. 这枚钻石戒指重一克拉。 | qirat->小豆角（阿拉伯语，宝石重量单位），carat->克拉（cf. carob角豆=古代重量单位，caret校对符号^，carrot胡萝卜，注意区分） || 文化联想：中国珠宝店买钻戒时用克拉衡量重量最适合帮助记忆 carat，可以说 **one carat — “A jewelry customer may compare two diamonds that each weigh about one carat.”**

quiz.question: __ technocrat
quiz.explanation: 技术官僚, IT技术官僚. The IT technocrat led the companys digital transformation. IT技术官僚领导了公司的数字化转型。 | techno->技术（希腊），crat->统治者，technocrat->靠技术统治的人（cf. democrat民主者，autocrat独裁者，aristocrat贵族） || 文化联想：中文“技术官僚”最适合帮助记忆 technocrat，可以说 **a policy technocrat — “A policy technocrat may rely heavily on data, models, and administrative expertise when designing reforms.”**

quiz.question: ______ aristocrat
quiz.explanation: 贵族, 法国贵族. The French aristocrat owned vast estates. 法国贵族拥有大片庄园。 | aristo->最好的（希腊aristos），crat->统治，aristocrat->由最好的人统治的=贵族（cf. aristocracy贵族制，democracy民主） || 文化联想：aristocrat 是欧洲贵族概念，可用中国学生学习法国史时来记忆，可以说 **a French aristocrat — “In a class on pre-revolutionary France, students may read about a French aristocrat who owned large estates and inherited privileges.”**

quiz.question: ________ autocrat
quiz.explanation: 独裁者, 绝对独裁者. The absolute autocrat ruled with unlimited power. 绝对独裁者以无限权力统治。 | auto->自己，crat->统治，autocrat->自己统治=独裁者（cf. autocracy独裁，autonomous自治，automobile汽车=自动行走） || 文化联想：中文“独断专行的统治者”最适合帮助记忆 autocrat，可以说 **an absolute autocrat — “A ruler who can make laws, punish opponents, and spend state funds without meaningful checks is an absolute autocrat.”**

quiz.question: _______ habitat
quiz.explanation: 栖息地, 自然栖息地. Deforestation destroys the natural habitat of many species. 森林砍伐破坏了许多物种的自然栖息地。 | habitat->它居住（拉丁habitare->居住），habitat->居住地=栖息地（cf. inhabit居住，habit习惯，inhabitant居民） || 文化联想：四川大熊猫自然保护区最适合帮助记忆 habitat，可以说 **a natural habitat — “Bamboo forests in southwestern China provide a natural habitat for giant pandas.”**

quiz.question: ________ hemostat
quiz.explanation: 止血钳, 外科止血钳. The surgeon used a surgical hemostat to control bleeding. 外科医生使用外科止血钳来控制出血。 | hemo->血（希腊），stat->停止（拉丁），hemostat->使血停止的器具=止血钳（cf. hemoglobin血红蛋白，static静态） || 文化联想：中国医院手术室里的止血钳最适合帮助记忆 hemostat，可以说 **a surgical hemostat — “A surgeon may clamp a bleeding vessel with a surgical hemostat during an operation.”**

quiz.question: ____ cravat
quiz.explanation: 领巾; 领带, 丝质领巾. The gentleman wore an elegant silk cravat. 这位绅士戴着一条优雅的丝质领巾。 | Croat->克罗地亚人，cravat->克罗地亚骑兵围巾，后演变为领带（17世纪法国时尚引入，necktie的前身） || 文化联想：cravat 是欧洲领巾，可用中国学生看民国西装照片时与领带前身作联系，可以说 **a silk cravat — “A fashion-history student may see a silk cravat in an old European-style portrait and recognize it as an ancestor of the modern necktie.”**

quiz.question: enact _______
quiz.explanation: 制定; 颁布, 颁布改革. The government will enact reforms to improve education. 政府将颁布改革以改善教育。 | en->使，act->行动，enact->使成为行动=颁布（cf. act行动，react反应，interact互动，enactment法规） || 文化联想：中文“通过法律把改革正式落地”最适合帮助记忆 enact，可以说 **enact reforms — “A legislature may enact reforms after months of debate and turn the proposals into law.”**

quiz.question: ____ _ pact
quiz.explanation: 协议; 条约, 签署协议. The nations agreed to sign a pact for mutual defense. 各国同意签署互防协议。 | pact->协议（拉丁pactum->协定），pact->协议/条约（cf. compact紧凑，impact冲击，peace和平=同根） || 文化联想：中文“签订盟约”最适合帮助记忆 pact，可以说 **sign a pact — “Two countries may sign a pact promising mutual assistance during a security crisis.”**

quiz.question: compact ___
quiz.explanation: 紧凑的; 小型的, 小型汽车. She drives a fuel-efficient compact car. 她开一辆节能的小型汽车。 | com->共同，pact->压紧（拉丁），compact->压缩在一起的=紧凑的（cf. impact冲击=冲进去，pact条约，pack打包） || 文化联想：中国城市里常见的小型两厢车最适合帮助记忆 compact，可以说 **a compact car — “A compact car is convenient in a crowded city because it is easier to park and maneuver.”**

quiz.question: counteract _______
quiz.explanation: 抵消; 对抗, 抵消影响. The medication will counteract effects of the poison. 这种药物将抵消毒药的影响。 | counter->对抗，act->行动，counteract->对抗行动=抵消（cf. react反应，interact互动，enact颁布） || 文化联想：中文“以毒攻毒、抵消副作用”最适合帮助记忆 counteract，可以说 **counteract an effect — “A doctor may prescribe one treatment to counteract an unwanted effect of another medication.”**

quiz.question: tract __ ____
quiz.explanation: 大片土地; 小册子, 大片土地. The farmer owned a large tract of land. 农民拥有一大片土地。 | tract->拉/延伸（拉丁trahere），tract->延伸的一片=大片土地/小册子（cf. tractor拖拉机，attract吸引，distract分心） || 文化联想：中国农村一大片连着的耕地最适合帮助记忆 tract，可以说 **a tract of land — “A farmer may lease a large tract of land for growing wheat or corn.”**

quiz.question: detract ____
quiz.explanation: 减损; 贬低, 减损. The minor flaws do not detract from the overall quality. 小瑕疵不会减损整体质量。 | de->向下，tract->拉，detract->向下拉=贬低减损（cf. attract吸引=向上拉，distract分散=拉向别处） || 文化联想：中文“瑕不掩瑜”最适合帮助记忆 detract，可以说 **detract from the quality — “A few tiny scratches do not necessarily detract from the overall quality of a well-made antique.”**

quiz.question: retract _________
quiz.explanation: 撤回; 收回, 撤回声明. The politician was forced to retract statement. 政客被迫撤回声明。 | re->回，tract->拉，retract->拉回去=撤回（cf. extract提取=拉出，protract拖延=拉长，contract合同=共同拉手） || 文化联想：中文“撤回声明”最适合帮助记忆 retract，可以说 **retract a statement — “A newspaper may retract a statement after discovering that the original information was false.”**

quiz.question: protract _______
quiz.explanation: 延长; 拖延, 延长争端. Legal complications will protract dispute for years. 法律复杂性将使争端延长数年。 | pro->向前，tract->拉，protract->向前拉长=拖延（cf. retract撤回，contract合同，detract贬低，protractor量角器） || 文化联想：中文“把官司拖上好几年”最适合帮助记忆 protract，可以说 **protract a dispute — “Repeated appeals and procedural delays can protract a dispute for years.”**

quiz.question: extract ____
quiz.explanation: 提取; 摘录, 提取数据. Scientists can extract data from the experiment results. 科学家可以从实验结果中提取数据。 | ex->向外，tract->拉，extract->向外拉出=提取（cf. attract吸引，retract撤回，tractor拖拉机=拉的机器） || 文化联想：程序员从日志中提取数据最适合帮助记忆 extract，可以说 **extract data — “An engineer may write a script to extract data from thousands of log files for analysis.”**

quiz.question: ______ tact
quiz.explanation: 机智; 圆滑, 社交机智. Diplomats require excellent social tact. 外交官需要出色的社交机智。 | tact->触摸（拉丁tangere），tact->感知分寸的触感=机智（cf. tactile触觉的，contact接触，tangible可触的，intact完整） || 文化联想：中文“说话有分寸”最适合帮助记忆 tact，可以说 **show tact — “Telling a colleague about a mistake privately rather than embarrassing that person in public shows tact.”**

quiz.question: contact ____
quiz.explanation: 接触; 联系, 隐形眼镜. She wears contact lens instead of glasses. 她戴隐形眼镜而不是眼镜。 | con->共同，tact->触摸，contact->共同触摸=接触/联系（cf. tact机智，tactile触觉，tangible可触，intact完整） || 文化联想：中国人戴隐形眼镜的日常最适合帮助记忆 contact，可以说 **a contact lens — “A person who does not want to wear glasses may use a contact lens to correct vision.”**

quiz.question: exact _______
quiz.explanation: 精确的; 确切的, 精确的数字. The report requires exact figures for all expenses. 报告需要所有费用的精确数字。 | ex->完全，act->驱动（拉丁agere），exact->完全驱动到位=精确的（cf. exacting苛刻的，exactly精确地，examine检查） || 文化联想：中文“精确到个位数”最适合帮助记忆 exact，可以说 **exact figures — “Before approving a budget, managers may ask for exact figures rather than rough estimates.”**

quiz.question: _____________ defect
quiz.explanation: 缺陷; 缺点, 制造缺陷. The recall was due to a manufacturing defect. 召回是由于制造缺陷。 | de->向下，fect->做（拉丁facere），defect->向下做=做坏了=缺陷/叛逃（cf. affect影响，infect感染，perfect完美=彻底做好） || 文化联想：中国制造业召回产品时常见“制造缺陷”最适合帮助记忆 defect，可以说 **a manufacturing defect — “A carmaker may recall thousands of vehicles after discovering a manufacturing defect in one component.”**

quiz.question: disaffect ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 使不满; 使疏远, 使基层不满. The policy changes will disaffect the base supporters. 政策变化将使基层支持者不满。 | dis->否定，affect->影响/感情，disaffect->使感情疏离=使不满（cf. affect影响，affection感情，effective有效的） || 文化联想：中文“把原本支持你的人也搞寒心”最适合帮助记忆 disaffect，可以说 **disaffect supporters — “A policy that repeatedly ignores core supporters may disaffect the very people who once backed it.”**

quiz.question: disinfect ________
quiz.explanation: 消毒, 消毒表面. Clean and disinfect surfaces regularly to prevent disease. 定期清洁和消毒表面以预防疾病。 | dis->去除，infect->感染，disinfect->去除感染=消毒（cf. infect感染，antiseptic防腐剂，sterilize灭菌） || 文化联想：中国家庭清洁厨房和卫生间表面时常用消毒剂，最适合帮助记忆 disinfect，可以说 **disinfect surfaces — “During flu season, a family may disinfect surfaces such as doorknobs and countertops more frequently.”**

quiz.question: ________ dialect
quiz.explanation: 方言, 地区方言. Each area has its own distinct regional dialect. 每个地区都有自己独特的地区方言。 | dia->通过，lect->说（希腊legein），dialect->在地区间流传的说法=方言（cf. dialogue对话，lecture演讲，select选择） || 文化联想：四川话、粤语等地区方言最适合帮助记忆 dialect，可以说 **a regional dialect — “A traveler in China may hear a regional dialect that differs greatly from standard Mandarin.”**

quiz.question: reflect __
quiz.explanation: 反射; 反思, 反思. Take time to reflect on your decisions. 花时间反思你的决定。 | re->回，flect->弯（拉丁flectere），reflect->弯折回来=反射/反思（cf. deflect偏转，inflect屈折，flexible灵活） || 文化联想：“吾日三省吾身”最适合帮助记忆 reflect，可以说 **reflect on one’s actions — “‘吾日三省吾身’ captures the habit of taking time to reflect on one’s actions and choices.”**

quiz.question: genuflect ______ _____
quiz.explanation: 屈膝; 跪拜, 在祭坛前跪拜. Worshippers genuflect before altar as a sign of respect. 崇拜者在祭坛前跪拜以示尊敬。 | genu->膝盖（拉丁genu），flect->弯曲，genuflect->弯膝=跪拜（cf. genuine真正的=从膝盖来，knee膝盖） || 文化联想：genuflect 是基督教礼仪中的屈膝动作，可用中国学生参观欧洲教堂时来记忆，可以说 **genuflect before the altar — “A Chinese visitor to a Catholic church may observe worshippers genuflect before the altar as a sign of reverence.”**

quiz.question: ____ intellect
quiz.explanation: 智力; 才智, 敏锐的智力. She possesses a keen intellect and analytical mind. 她拥有敏锐的智力和分析性思维。 | inter->在...之间，lect->选择（拉丁legere），intellect->在概念间选择=智力（cf. select选择，elect选举，collect收集） || 文化联想：中文“聪明才智”最适合帮助记忆 intellect，可以说 **a keen intellect — “A mathematician who quickly sees the structure of a difficult proof may possess a keen intellect.”**

quiz.question: ______ aspect
quiz.explanation: 方面; 面貌, 面部特征. The doctor noted unusual facial aspect in the patient. 医生注意到病人不寻常的面部特征。 | a->朝向，spect->看，aspect->朝向某方向看=方面/面貌（cf. inspect检查，prospect前景，respect尊重，suspect怀疑） || 文化联想：中医望诊或西医检查都可能观察面部状态，可帮助记忆 aspect，可以说 **facial aspect — “A doctor may note a patient’s unusual facial aspect as one clue among many during an examination.”**

quiz.question: ______ prospect
quiz.explanation: 前景; 展望, 职业前景. The job offers excellent career prospect for growth. 这份工作为成长提供了极好的职业前景。 | pro->向前，spect->看，prospect->向前看=前景（cf. inspect检查，aspect方面，retrospect回顾，expect期待） || 文化联想：中文“职业前景”最适合帮助记忆 prospect，可以说 **career prospects — “Learning an in-demand technical skill can improve a graduate’s career prospects.”**

quiz.question: suspect ______
quiz.explanation: 怀疑; 嫌疑犯, 可疑的动机. Police questioned him about his suspect motive. 警方询问他关于可疑动机的问题。 | sub->从下，spect->看，suspect->从下面暗中观察=怀疑（cf. aspect方面，inspect检查，despise鄙视=从上往下看） || 文化联想：中文“动机可疑”最适合帮助记忆 suspect，可以说 **a suspect motive — “If someone offers help only after learning that money is involved, others may question the person’s suspect motive.”**

quiz.question: resurrect _ _____
quiz.explanation: 复活; 使复兴, 复兴一个品牌. The company plans to resurrect a brand from the 1980s. 公司计划复兴一个1980年代的品牌。 | re->再次，surrect->升起（拉丁surgere），resurrect->再次升起=复活（cf. insurrection叛乱=起身反抗，surge涌现） || 文化联想：中文“让老字号重新复活”最适合帮助记忆 resurrect，可以说 **resurrect a brand — “A company may resurrect a brand from the 1980s by redesigning its products for a new generation.”**

quiz.question: _________ sect
quiz.explanation: 教派; 宗派, 宗教派别. The religious sect has unique beliefs and practices. 该宗教派别有独特的信仰和实践。 | sect->切/跟随（拉丁sequi/secare），sect->从大群体切出的小派别（cf. section截面，bisect二等分，dissect解剖） || 文化联想：sect 是宗教派别，可用中国学生学习世界宗教时来记忆，可以说 **a religious sect — “In a world-religions class, students may study how a religious sect develops distinct beliefs and practices.”**

quiz.question: _____ intersect
quiz.explanation: 相交; 交叉, 道路相交. The two roads intersect at the traffic light. 这两条道路在红绿灯处相交。 | inter->之间，sect->切，intersect->在中间切过=相交（cf. bisect二等分，dissect解剖，section截面） || 文化联想：北京立交桥和城市十字路口最适合帮助记忆 intersect，可以说 **roads intersect — “Two major roads may intersect at a busy junction controlled by traffic lights.”**

quiz.question: dissect ____
quiz.explanation: 解剖; 剖析, 解剖青蛙. Biology students learn to dissect frog in laboratory. 生物学学生在实验室学习解剖青蛙。 | dis->分开，sect->切，dissect->切开分开=解剖（cf. section截面，bisect二等分，intersect相交） || 文化联想：中国中学生物课里的青蛙解剖最适合帮助记忆 dissect，可以说 **dissect a frog — “In a biology laboratory, students may dissect a frog to examine its internal organs.”**

quiz.question: ________ edict
quiz.explanation: 法令; 敕令, 皇家敕令. The emperor issued an imperial edict throughout the kingdom. 皇帝在全国颁布了皇家敕令。 | e->向外，dict->说（拉丁dicere），edict->公开说出的=敕令（cf. dictate命令，predict预测，contradict反驳，verdict裁决） || 文化联想：古代皇帝颁布诏令最适合帮助记忆 edict，可以说 **an imperial edict — “In a historical drama, an emperor may issue an imperial edict that officials must carry out across the realm.”**

quiz.question: indict __ _______
quiz.explanation: 起诉; 控告, 以罪名起诉. The grand jury will indict on charges of fraud. 大陪审团将以欺诈罪名起诉。 | in->进入，dict->宣告，indict->正式宣告起诉（注意c不发音，cf. indicate指示，verdict裁决，dictate命令） || 文化联想：indict 是英美刑事法律术语，可用中国法学生学习美国司法制度时来记忆，可以说 **indict on charges — “A Chinese law student may learn that a grand jury can indict a defendant on criminal charges in the U.S. system.”**

quiz.question: _____ __ interdict
quiz.explanation: 禁令; 阻止, 发布禁令. The court will issue an interdict against the company. 法院将对该公司发布禁令。 | inter->之间，dict->说，interdict->从中间用话语阻止=禁令（cf. predict预测，edict敕令，contradict反驳） || 文化联想：interdict 是正式“禁止令”，可用法院禁令语境来记忆，可以说 **issue an interdict — “A court may issue an interdict ordering a party to stop a prohibited action.”**

quiz.question: ____ verdict
quiz.explanation: 裁决; 判决, 陪审团裁决. The jury verdict found the defendant guilty. 陪审团裁决被告有罪。 | ver->真，dict->说，verdict->说出真相=裁决（cf. veracious真实，verity真理，dictate命令，predict预言） || 文化联想：中文“陪审团裁决”最适合帮助记忆 verdict，可以说 **a jury verdict — “At the end of a trial, a jury verdict may find the defendant guilty or not guilty.”**

quiz.question: afflict ____ ____
quiz.explanation: 折磨; 使痛苦, 使遭受痛苦. Arthritis can afflict with pain for years. 关节炎可以使人遭受多年痛苦。 | af->朝向，flict->打击（拉丁fligere），afflict->打击加身=折磨（cf. conflict冲突，inflict施加，infliction施加痛苦） || 文化联想：中文“病痛折磨多年”最适合帮助记忆 afflict，可以说 **afflict with pain — “Severe arthritis can afflict a patient with pain and stiffness for many years.”**

quiz.question: depict _ _____
quiz.explanation: 描绘; 描述, 描绘场景. The painting accurately depict a scene from history. 这幅画准确地描绘了历史场景。 | de->彻底，pict->画（拉丁pingere），depict->彻底画出=描绘（cf. picture图片，picturesque如画，pigment颜料） || 文化联想：《清明上河图》描绘市井生活最适合帮助记忆 depict，可以说 **depict a scene — “Along the River During the Qingming Festival depicts a busy urban scene filled with merchants, travelers, boats, and shops.”**

quiz.question: evict ______
quiz.explanation: 驱逐; 逐出, 驱逐租户. The landlord tried to evict tenant for nonpayment. 房东试图因不付款而驱逐租户。 | e->向外，vict->征服（拉丁vincere），evict->征服驱出=驱逐（cf. victory胜利，convict定罪，convince说服） || 文化联想：中国租赁纠纷里依法要求欠租租客搬离最适合帮助记忆 evict，可以说 **evict a tenant — “A landlord may seek to evict a tenant for serious nonpayment only through the required legal process.”**

quiz.question: convict _ _____
quiz.explanation: 定罪; 证明有罪, 给小偷定罪. The jury will convict a thief based on the evidence. 陪审团将根据证据给小偷定罪。 | con->完全，vict->征服，convict->完全征服=定罪/囚犯（cf. evict驱逐，convince说服，conviction定罪/信念） || 文化联想：中文“证据确凿后定罪”最适合帮助记忆 convict，可以说 **convict a thief — “A court may convict a thief only after the evidence proves guilt under the applicable legal standard.”**

quiz.question: mulct _ ______
quiz.explanation: 罚款; 诈取, 诈骗受害者. The scammer tried to mulct a victim of their savings. 骗子试图诈骗受害者的积蓄。 | mulct->罚款（拉丁mulctare），mulct->以罚款或欺诈手段索取（cf. milk剥削=榨取，fleeced被骗=被剃了羊毛） || 文化联想：中文“巧立名目榨钱”最适合帮助记忆 mulct，可以说 **mulct a victim — “A dishonest operator may invent fake fees to mulct a victim of hard-earned savings.”**

quiz.question: distinct _________
quiz.explanation: 明显的; 清楚的, 明显的优势. Experience gives her a distinct advantage in hiring. 经验给她在招聘中带来了明显的优势。 | dis->分开，stinct->刺/标记（拉丁stinguere），distinct->用标记分开=明显区别的（cf. instinct本能，extinct灭绝，distinguish区分） || 文化联想：中文“明显优势”最适合帮助记忆 distinct，可以说 **a distinct advantage — “Fluency in both Chinese and English can give a candidate a distinct advantage for some international roles.”**

quiz.question: defunct _______
quiz.explanation: 不再存在的; 倒闭的, 倒闭的公司. The defunct company closed operations last year. 这家倒闭的公司去年停止了运营。 | de->完全，funct->功能（拉丁fungi->执行），defunct->功能完全停止的=倒闭的（cf. function功能，malfunction故障，fungible可替代的） || 文化联想：中文“已经倒闭、不复存在”最适合帮助记忆 defunct，可以说 **a defunct company — “An old factory brand may still appear on vintage signs even though the original company is now defunct.”**

quiz.question: ___ duct
quiz.explanation: 管道, 空气管道. The air duct system circulates fresh air throughout the building. 空气管道系统在整栋建筑中循环新鲜空气。 | duct->引导（拉丁ducere），duct->引导流体的管道（cf. conduct传导，educate教育=引导出来，abduct绑架=带走） || 文化联想：中国写字楼中央空调的通风管道最适合帮助记忆 duct，可以说 **an air duct — “An air duct carries heated or cooled air through different parts of a building.”**

quiz.question: abduct _____
quiz.explanation: 绑架; 诱拐, 绑架儿童. Criminals attempted to abduct child from the playground. 罪犯试图从操场上绑架儿童。 | ab->离开，duct->引导/带，abduct->带离=绑架（cf. duct管道，educate教育，induce引导，conduct传导） || 文化联想：中文“拐走儿童”最适合帮助记忆 abduct，可以说 **abduct a child — “Police may issue an urgent alert when criminals attempt to abduct a child from a public place.”**

quiz.question: deduct ___
quiz.explanation: 扣除; 减去, 扣除税款. The company will deduct tax from your paycheck. 公司将从你的薪水中扣除税款。 | de->向下/去除，duct->引导，deduct->引导去除=扣除（cf. deduce推断，introduce介绍，reduce减少） || 文化联想：中国工资单里自动扣税最适合帮助记忆 deduct，可以说 **deduct tax — “An employer may deduct tax and other required contributions before paying an employee’s net salary.”**

quiz.question: _____ aqueduct
quiz.explanation: 渡槽; 输水道, 罗马渡槽. The ancient Roman aqueduct still stands today. 古老的罗马渡槽至今仍然屹立。 | aqua->水，duct->引导，aqueduct->引导水流的建筑=渡槽（cf. aquatic水生的，aquifer含水层，duct管道） || 文化联想：aqueduct 是古罗马输水道，可用中国学生学习古罗马工程时来记忆，可以说 **a Roman aqueduct — “A Chinese student studying ancient engineering may learn how a Roman aqueduct carried water across long distances by gravity.”**

quiz.question: ____ conduct
quiz.explanation: 传导; 进行, 传导热量. Metals conduct heat efficiently through their structure. 金属通过其结构有效地传导热量。 | con->共同，duct->引导，conduct->引导通过=传导/行为（cf. conductor指挥，aqueduct渡槽，semiconductor半导体） || 文化联想：中国物理课里的金属导热最适合帮助记忆 conduct，可以说 **conduct heat — “A metal spoon becomes hot quickly in boiling soup because metal can conduct heat efficiently.”**

quiz.question: construct _ ______
quiz.explanation: 建造; 构造, 建造一座桥. Engineers will construct a bridge across the river. 工程师将在河上建造一座桥。 | con->共同，struct->建造（拉丁struere），construct->共同建造（cf. destroy摧毁，instruct指导，obstruct阻碍，structure结构） || 文化联想：中国桥梁建设最适合帮助记忆 construct，可以说 **construct a bridge — “Engineers may construct a bridge across a river to connect communities on opposite banks.”**

quiz.question: facet __ ____
quiz.explanation: 方面; 侧面, 生活的方面. Education affects every facet of life. 教育影响生活的各个方面。 | facet->小面（法语，face的指小词），facet->切割宝石的一个面=方面（cf. face脸，surface表面，facetious开玩笑） || 文化联想：中文“生活的方方面面”最适合帮助记忆 facet，可以说 **a facet of life — “Education influences nearly every facet of life, from employment to health and civic participation.”**

quiz.question: dulcet _____
quiz.explanation: 悦耳的; 甜美的, 悦耳的音调. The singers dulcet tones captivated the audience. 歌手悦耳的音调迷住了观众。 | dulc->甜（拉丁dulcis），dulcet->甜美的=悦耳的（cf. dulcimer扬琴，indulge放纵=使甜蜜，dolce甜美的意大利语） || 文化联想：古筝或笛子柔和悦耳的声音最适合帮助记忆 dulcet，可以说 **dulcet tones — “A bamboo flute can produce dulcet tones that sound soft and soothing in a quiet garden.”**

quiz.question: ________ lancet
quiz.explanation: 柳叶刀; 刺血针, 外科刺血针. The doctor used a surgical lancet for the procedure. 医生用外科刺血针进行手术。 | lance->长矛，lancet->小长矛=刺血针（cf. lance长矛，lance下士=用矛的人，The Lancet医学杂志=柳叶刀） || 文化联想：中国医院手术器械里的小型柳叶刀最适合帮助记忆 lancet，可以说 **a surgical lancet — “A doctor may use a surgical lancet to make a very small, precise incision.”**

quiz.question: faucet ______
quiz.explanation: 水龙头, 水龙头把手. Turn the faucet handle clockwise to stop the flow. 顺时针转动水龙头把手以停止流水。 | fausset->小塞子（古法语），faucet->控制液体的阀门=水龙头（cf. faucet美式英语，tap英式英语） || 文化联想：中国家庭厨房漏水的水龙头最适合帮助记忆 faucet，可以说 **a faucet handle — “Turning the faucet handle tightly may stop the water flow, but a worn washer can still cause dripping.”**

quiz.question: _____ cadet
quiz.explanation: 学员; 军校学员, 海军学员. The naval cadet trained at the military academy. 海军学员在军事学院接受训练。 | cadet->小头目（法语，gascon方言capdet），cadet->年幼的弟弟/军校学员（cf. captain队长，chef主厨=头，cattle牛群） || 文化联想：中国海军院校里的年轻学员最适合帮助记忆 cadet，可以说 **a naval cadet — “A naval cadet may study navigation, engineering, discipline, and seamanship at a military academy.”**

quiz.question: fleet __ _____
quiz.explanation: 舰队; 车队, 船队. The navy deployed a fleet of ships to the region. 海军向该地区部署了一支船队。 | fleet->快速/浮动（古英语flot->水流），fleet->快速移动的舰队（cf. flow流动，float漂浮，fleet-footed脚步轻快） || 文化联想：中国海军的一支舰队最适合帮助记忆 fleet，可以说 **a fleet of ships — “A navy may deploy a fleet of ships for training, patrol, or disaster relief.”**

quiz.question: __ discreet
quiz.explanation: 谨慎的; 小心的, 保持谨慎. Please be discreet about this confidential matter. 请对这件机密事务保持谨慎。 | dis->分开，creet->筛选（拉丁cernere），discreet->仔细筛选分辨的=谨慎的（cf. discrete分离的，discern辨别，secret秘密） || 文化联想：中文“这事要低调、别到处说”最适合帮助记忆 discreet，可以说 **be discreet — “When handling a colleague’s private information, it is important to be discreet and avoid unnecessary discussion.”**

quiz.question: _____ gadget
quiz.explanation: 小装置; 小器具, 方便的小器具. This handy gadget makes cooking much easier. 这个方便的小器具使烹饪变得容易得多。 | gadget->来源不明（可能来自法语gâchette->门闩），gadget->小机械装置（cf. widget小组件，gizmo小玩意） || 文化联想：中国厨房里的各种便捷小工具最适合帮助记忆 gadget，可以说 **a handy gadget — “A small garlic press can be a handy gadget that saves time while cooking.”**

quiz.question: midget ___
quiz.explanation: 侏儒; 微型的, 微型汽车. He raced a midget car at the local track. 他在当地赛道上驾驶微型汽车比赛。 | midge->微小昆虫（古英语mycg），midget->比蚊子还小的人=极小的（cf. midge蚊蚋，widget小组件） || 文化联想：midget 在这里指赛车级别，不用于称呼人；可用小型赛车来记忆，可以说 **a midget car — “At a motorsport event, a driver may race a lightweight midget car around a short oval track.”**

quiz.question: budget _______
quiz.explanation: 预算, 预算赤字. The government faces a large budget deficit this year. 政府今年面临巨大的预算赤字。 | bougette->小皮包（法语，bouge->皮袋），budget->装钱的小包=预算（英国财政大臣每年从皮包取出预算方案） || 文化联想：中文“财政赤字”最适合帮助记忆 budget，可以说 **a budget deficit — “If annual government spending exceeds revenue, the result is a budget deficit.”**

quiz.question: beget _______
quiz.explanation: 产生; 引起, 产生结果. Hard work will beget results in the long run. 从长远来看,努力工作将产生结果。 | be->使，get->得到（古英语），beget->使得到=产生/生育（cf. forget忘记，get获得，beget=father a child） || 文化联想：中文“种瓜得瓜、因果相生”最适合帮助记忆 beget，可以说 **beget results — “Consistent practice can beget results over time, just as repeated effort gradually produces skill.”**

quiz.question: _____ cachet
quiz.explanation: 威望; 声誉, 品牌声誉. The designer label has significant brand cachet. 这个设计师品牌有显著的品牌声誉。 | cacher->隐藏（法语），cachet->隐藏的特别印记=声誉（注意t不发音，cf. cache缓存=隐藏的东西，cachet威望） || 文化联想：中文“品牌光环、江湖地位”最适合帮助记忆 cachet，可以说 **brand cachet — “A luxury label may command higher prices because its name carries strong brand cachet.”**

quiz.question: crochet ____
quiz.explanation: 钩针编织, 钩针编织钩. She used a crochet hook to make a blanket. 她用钩针编织钩制作了一条毯子。 | crochet->小钩（法语，crochet=小钩子），crochet->用小钩编织=钩针编织（注意t不发音，cf. crotch叉，crotchet四分音符） || 文化联想：中国奶奶用钩针织围巾或毯子最适合帮助记忆 crochet，可以说 **a crochet hook — “A grandmother may use a crochet hook to make a scarf from loops of yarn.”**

quiz.question: ________ prophet
quiz.explanation: 先知; 预言家, 圣经先知. The biblical prophet warned of coming disasters. 圣经先知警告即将到来的灾难。 | pro->提前，phet->说（希腊phemi），prophet->提前说出=先知（cf. prophecy预言，blasphemy亵渎=说坏话，euphemism委婉说法） || 文化联想：prophet 是宗教“先知”，可用中国学生学习《圣经》文化时来记忆，可以说 **a biblical prophet — “In a Bible-literature class, students may read about a biblical prophet who warns people about future consequences.”**

quiz.question: ______ epithet
quiz.explanation: 绰号; 称号, 种族侮辱语. Using a racial epithet is never acceptable. 使用种族侮辱语是永远不能接受的。 | epi->在上，thet->放（希腊tithenai），epithet->附加在上面的称号=绰号（cf. thesis论文，synthesis综合，atheist无神论者） || 文化联想：中文“给人扣上侮辱性称号”最适合帮助记忆 epithet，可以说 **an insulting epithet — “Using a degrading label for an ethnic or social group is using an insulting epithet.”**

quiz.question: whet ___ ________
quiz.explanation: 磨快; 刺激, 刺激食欲. The appetizer will whet the appetite for the main course. 开胃菜将刺激人们对主菜的食欲。 | whet->磨快（古英语hwettan），whet->磨利/刺激（whet the appetite->磨锐食欲=开胃，whetstone磨刀石） || 文化联想：中文“开胃菜把胃口吊起来”最适合帮助记忆 whet，可以说 **whet the appetite — “A small plate of pickled vegetables before dinner may whet the appetite for the main dishes.”**
